name: Sir_Rebral
summary: Most precise route-detail commenter. He found the Garou Thane walking through the bars (an air charge without the rat room), the charge-pad edge trick that keeps elementals from spawning, the surge+dash into an invisible wall that unlocks a lodestone, and the faster necromancer route. He relayed SectorTSWG's Fragments skip to Nanobit and quotes Jagex's reddit post.

insights.text: @zyneater  There's an invisible wall stopping you from landing on the other side but surge+dashing into the invisible wall will unlock the lodestone if you do it from the edge where the water bridge starts. The death warp is even faster now with the air attack you fall to your death a lot quicker.

video.title: Full Kuldra Run Skip - Post 1.0.1 Patch | Runescape Dragonwilds

insights.verification_note: Same mechanic as SamFPlays' "hit the left side of the rocks... it unlocks the teleporter" (ESrrkdxD1fo 3:45). Death warp is faster with the jump attack.

insights.text:
Great video dude :)

At 8:25 you don't have to go so high, you can go straight from where you are as you crouch through the hole. The video on my channel shows it if you want to see but yeah no need to windstep up higher

at 12:39 the way to not agro them is to just touch the front edge of the circle that gives you charge, you still gain charge on the edge but the enemies wont spawn until you move further forward also if you do the air part first you can start creating the orb while you do the fire pylon, then grab the orb on the way back and recharge yourself with air

video.title: Kuldra Scorned Wilderness Full Raid Skip Guide (Patch 1.0.1) | Runescape Dragonwilds

insights.text: For the stronghold you don't need to get the air charge from the room with the rats, if you just walk towards the room with the Thane in it on the right he'll walk through the bars. Kill him and you'll be charged then windstep up through the barrier.

video.title: (Patched!)11 Min Full Kuldra Speedrun (Post-Patch 1.0.1) - Follow Along | RS Dragonwilds

insights.verification_note: Used by Nanobit (8:32 run notes) and in the SamFPlays route. The Thane takes ~15 min to respawn (Nanobit).

insights.text: Fastest is a bit of a lie but that first skip next to the black dragon is new to me. For the Stronghold, you don't need to mine the wall or kill the rats just let the Thane walk out of the room on the right as you enter (he likes to walk through the metal bars) kill him then windstep up. You also don't need to bother activating the ledges in the elemental room either you can just windstep up on to the pipe

video.title: Fastest Kuldra Run Runescape Dragonwilds post Patch 1.0.1 Raid skips!

insights.text:
There is a better skip for the necromancer area than the one you used in the video. After you walk through the earth barrier drop down to the vine below then jump around to a rock and surge+dash across, and at 4:49 you can just surge+dash across the entire chasm instead of going around the edge. I threw a quick video together and posted it if you wanted to see those they're in there but my pathing leaves a lot to be desired for the first one lol. The rest of my video you already know and I didn't know about the Elemental skip when I made that so thanks for showcasing that one :D 

Great video dude keep it up. Hopefully Jagex don't go too hard patching these, I'm having a lot of fun running the raid with skips.

video.title: (Patched!) Sub 10 Min Kuldra Skip Guide (Post-Patch 1.0.1) – Every Skip Explained | RS Dragonwilds

insights.text: I just did a run and you can still surge+dash across the broken bridge to get to the final platform

video.title: Fastest Kuldra Run Runescape Dragonwilds post Patch 1.0.1 Raid skips!

insights.verification_note: Was true on 10-20. FastTipsGaming (10-27) says the bridge itself was patched later.

insights.text:
It doesn't matter what you're holding no, just make sure you have forward momentum by moving before you surge. It can be tricky and until you get the hang of it I recommend using recall and if you miss you can just teleport back

There's also a new out of bounds skip for Cataclysm keep, you can see that in action on iNanobit's run on his channel or SamFPlays

video.title: Scorned Wilderness Skips 1.0.1 (missing Cataclysm Keep skip, just solve it asap)

insights.text:
From the latest reddit post by jagex: "Fixes for skips in the Scorned Wilderness Raid." are incoming...

I've been enjoying speedrunning and watching speed runs of the raid but it looks like they're adamant about forcing us all to do it the intended way.
Clean af sub 7 is definitely possible 💪 the extra hit after the Thane kill broke my heart haha. Keep it up man, hopefully see a sub 7 before more patches
insights.verification_note: TexasPete did 6:50 on an earlier route.

insights.text: @SectorTSWG  I uploaded a video with the skips I know of personally including the one I just learned from your video so I've credited you in the description

1.0.1 patched a few of the original skips, the most obvious one being the OOB during Cataclysm Keep, there's currently no skip (that I know of) for that area so just solve the puzzle fast with smart pathing.

0:00 Dragontail Vines
0:53 Skip to Fragments of Ghornfell
1:58 Skip across to Stronghold
2:48 Air barrier and skip across to Cataclysm Keep
4:02 Kuldra

The skip to Fragments of Ghornfell I saw in a video by @SectorTSWG 

Jagex have said there will be "Fixes for skips in the Scorned Wilderness Raid." in a coming update soon, so have fun running the raid with skips while you can.
